title: Cover and document explicit verification during retained federation requalification
outcome: Operator verification behavior while reconnect recovery is pending is explicit and tested, including restoration of prior Active or Draining state.
acceptance: A deterministic explicit-verify test with pending retained qualification confirms the intended membership result for prior Verified, Active and Draining without granting new initial activation.
Satellite onboarding documentation describes that behavior; any reachable retained-authority mismatch remains fail-closed and is covered or shown unreachable by current mutators.
